name: @vibe/desktop
description: Tauri desktop shell wrapping the Vibe T&B staff web app, adding native window capture for Capture Client Info.
comment: No 'dev'/'build' scripts on purpose: those names are picked up by the root's `pnpm -r` fan-out, and this package needs a Rust toolchain the web CI does not have. Drive it explicitly: `pnpm --filter @vibe/desktop tauri dev|build`.
